How an administrator gets back in

Tap the top corner on the side the text starts from, seven times within three seconds. That opens this console on its PIN screen and nothing else — it unlocks nothing on its own. Leaving or changing kiosk always needs the administrator PIN, so keep the recovery code somewhere safe. Without the PIN and without the recovery code, only re-provisioning the device removes kiosk.
Only installed apps that a person can actually open are listed, including apps this policy currently hides.

Device Guard itself, essential system components, the management transport, and known escape surfaces such as file managers and document pickers are never offered, because pinning one of those would hand over the way out.
